news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (1.4x net interest cover). news.title: Kalyan Capitals Limited Announces Resignation of Rohit Kumar as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective February 4, 2026
news.body: Kalyan Capitals Limited announced that Mr. Rohit Kumar has tendered his resignation from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) of the Company vide his letter dated January 23, 2026. Mr. Rohit Kumar will be relieved from his responsibilities with effect from close of business hours of February 4, 2026. Mr. Rohit Kumar cited personal reasons and professional growth as the reasons for his resignation.
